description: Clinical Evidence: registered trials with version history, posted results, EU registry and regulatory records, linked publications and preprints, trial-design methodology, outcome switching and an explained strength-of-evidence view over the Science providers. Not medical advice.

vocabulary.question: clinical question (population, condition, intervention, comparator)
vocabulary.strength: explained evidence-base description, not a clinical conclusion

profiles.description: Surveillance dossier: a condition and a geography to each source's series with case-definition revisions, reporting and reference dates, vintages, MeSH/ICD alignment, boundary projection and explicitly cited trials and publications, sources side by side

vocabulary.reporting date: when the case or value was reported to the public-health authority (Meldedatum, GHO Date)
vocabulary.reference date: the date or period the value refers to (onset, Refdatum, reference year); never the reporting date
vocabulary.case definition: the source's definition revision in force on a value's reference date; a change is a marked break
vocabulary.kind: observation, estimate (with bounds where given) or model output; never presented as another kind
vocabulary.vintage: one release of a series; earlier vintages stay addressable and pinned views turn stale
vocabulary.reporting delay: the source's own statement about incomplete recent periods; no nowcast is computed

workflow_defaults.as_of: the vintage released by the requested reporting date; values without a reporting date listed apart
workflow_defaults.sources: side by side; nothing merged, averaged or preferred
workflow_defaults.thresholds: user-configured only; never derived or suggested
workflow_defaults.never: Published surveillance values as each source released them: no outbreak prediction, nowcast, completeness estimate, threshold suggestion or health advice; case-definition changes are marked breaks, never corrections.
